{{Quote|Dark Lord Murbek Gehn dwells on the edge of the Dark Heart, studying its power. He alone has managed to withstand the madness.|Darth Severin|<ref name="The Mad Sith Lord" />}}
'''Murbek Gehn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was present on [[Voss]] where he studied the powers of the [[Dark Heart]]. He later aided an Imperial-aligned individual with passage into the [[Nightmare Lands]].
